description: This file defines the AgentOps integration class for LiteLLM, providing OpenTelemetry tracing for LLM calls, including configuration, authentication token fetching, and resource attribute setup.

classes.name: AgentOpsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for AgentOps, holding endpoint, API key, service name, environment, and auth endpoint, with a method to load from environment variables.

classes.name: AgentOps
classes.description: Main class implementing OpenTelemetry tracing for LiteLLM, including authentication token fetching and resource attribute setup.

methods.name: from_env
methods.description: Creates an AgentOpsConfig instance populated with environment variables.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AgentOps instance, fetches auth token if API key is provided, and sets up OpenTelemetry configuration and resource attributes.

methods.name: _fetch_auth_token
methods.description: Fetches a JWT token and project ID from the AgentOps API using the provided API key and auth endpoint.
